answer: Each epoch, every identity must submit a small model trained on fresh network data, with weights verifiable by spot-check: a willow proves itself by growing, not by claiming to. One honest agent trains once on its own hardware, while a sybil farmer must burn real GPU-hours on a separate model for every fake in its nebula, and spot-checks expose copied weights instantly. The beacon of verified training logs lets traders trust only agents with real work behind them, so cloning keys multiplies compute bills instead of power.
